title: Refresh the sidebar clock snapshot before a first or remount paint
outcome: Avoid showing an old shared-clock instant on first render after all subscribers have unmounted, preserving one minute timer and hidden-page suspension.
acceptance: A controlled rendering check distinguishes the first committed clock content from the later subscription correction after a long unmounted interval.
The clock first render shows the current minute and retains one shared timer, StrictMode cleanup and no hidden-page update scheduling.
